integrity: Proof is exact but limited to the stated seven-vertex finite classification. Existence of an unlocated stronger prior theorem remains possible. No external validation or independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved for finite connected undirected trees with 2 to 7 vertices, one perfectly vaccinated and deleted vertex, independent homogeneous bond transmissibility p in (0,1), uniform post-deletion initial infection, and the event of at least three infected. Does not extend to larger orders, loops, temporal SIR dependencies, multiple vaccines, uncertain seeds, or clinical settings.
title: Seven vertices are sharp for transmission-dependent vaccination against three-case outbreaks
